crossRefs.note: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with…
but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God…
What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is…
to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these…
For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they…
You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen; and the Lord Yahweh will kill you. He will call his servants by…
I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and…
I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed…
A curse will be taken up about them by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘Yahweh make you like…
For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and my wrath has been poured out on the inhabitants of…
It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save…

translations.web: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.
translations.bsb: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.
translations.kjv: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
translations.asv: And when he hath made her drink the water, then it shall come to pass, if she be defiled, and have committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her and become bitter, and her body shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
